_partNote: Class images for the explorer tiles, rendered at about 74px. Four of the seven subjects are containers of one sort or another, which is what a recycling sheet is made of, so each is given a different proportion and one distinguishing feature rather than being drawn as a box: a tapered wheeled cart with a hinged lid, a bound cube of crushed bottles, a long low open skip with a hook bar, and a tall cabinet with a round port. The other three are a stacked group of tapered ingots, an open drum filled with powder, and a thin flat board. The palette override has to forbid green explicitly — every real object in this domain is green or blue, and the model reaches for it.
style: Minimalist technical illustration, the style of a precise patent drawing crossed with an isometric product sketch. Uniform-weight dark slate-gray ink linework with sparse, muted steel-blue accent shading (hex 4E7AA8) on a plain very light warm-gray background (hex F2F3F1). Three-quarter isometric view, single centered subject, generous margins. No text, no labels, no callouts, no logos, no humans, no background scenery, no drop shadows. Clean, engineered, calm. Strictly two colors plus the background: dark slate-gray line and muted steel-blue fill. Every material, including plastic bins, painted steel, rust and printed labels, is drawn in that same palette. Absolutely no green, copper, brass, bronze, gold, orange, red or yellow anywhere, even where the real object would be that color, and no recycling symbol, arrows or markings of any kind. Favor open, airy linework with large unfilled light areas over heavy solid gray shading; the drawing should read as line art, not as a rendered solid model. Draw the subject as one whole object seen from outside. Do not draw a cutaway, a section view or an exploded assembly.

partPrompts.1: A single two-wheeled curbside waste cart standing on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a tall molded plastic bin whose body tapers so it is clearly wider at the top than at the base, with a flat hinged lid propped open at an angle, a straight tubular pull handle across the back at the top, and two small solid wheels on a short axle at the bottom rear. Empty inside. One cart alone, no bags, no contents spilling out, no truck, no curb, no markings on the body.
partPrompts.2: Three metal ingots stacked in a low pyramid on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: each ingot a plain rectangular block with noticeably sloped ends and sides so it tapers toward the top face, two lying side by side on the ground and the third resting across them. Heavy, blunt and geometric, with a slightly rough cast texture on the faces. Nothing else in the frame: no pallet, no strapping, no furnace, no markings.
partPrompts.3: A single open-topped steel drum standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a plain cylindrical drum with two raised rolling hoops around its middle and a rolled rim at the open top, filled with dark coarse granular powder that is heaped slightly above the rim in a low mound. The powder surface reads as loose grains. One drum, no lid, no clamp ring, no forklift, no scoop, no second container.
partPrompts.4: A single discarded printed circuit board lying flat on a plain surface, seen three-quarter from above: a thin flat rectangular board with a row of plain unplated edge contacts along one long edge, three flat rectangular chips of different sizes on its upper face, two short upright cylindrical capacitors, and a few small mounting holes at the corners. Flat and thin, seen from slightly above so it reads as a plane. No cables, no enclosure, no computer, no dense field of tiny components, no bright colors.
partPrompts.5: A single compressed bale of crushed plastic bottles sitting on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a squat rectangular block roughly as tall as it is wide, its faces made of tightly packed crushed bottle shapes with visible necks and ribs pressed flat against the surface, bound by four straight horizontal wires running around it. Dense and solid, one bale alone. No pallet, no forklift, no baler machine, no loose bottles beside it, no color.
partPrompts.6: A single open roll-off waste container sitting on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a long low open-topped steel box, clearly much longer than it is tall, with one end wall slanting inward, a straight lifting hook bar standing at that end, plain vertical stiffening ribs down the outside of the long sides, and two small rollers at the base of the opposite end. Empty inside. Long, low and open, one container alone: no truck, no contents, no lid, no wheels underneath.
partPrompts.7: A single reverse vending machine standing upright on a flat surface, seen three-quarter: a tall narrow floor-standing cabinet about twice as tall as it is wide, with one plain round opening set in the upper half of the flat front face, a small blank recessed panel just above that opening, and a plain kickplate at the base. Tall, blank and slab-sided, with the single circular opening the only feature on the front. No screen graphics, no buttons, no bottles, no signage, no shop around it.
